material_findings.title: Army formally launches xTech|Search 10 and opens applications
material_findings.summary: The Army FUZE xTech Program has now formally launched xTech|Search 10. Its official dated announcement says applications are open to eligible U.S. small businesses, offers up to $1 million in cash prizes, adds Phase I Army SBIR and for the first time STTR award opportunities valued up to $300,000 each, and sets the application deadline at October 19, 2026 at 5:00 PM ET. USA.gov independently lists the same Sep. 10-Oct. 19 application window and $1 million cash-prize headline.
material_findings.eligibility_and_cost: The Army launch announcement limits applications to eligible U.S. small businesses. The complete RFI/application package should be preserved before asserting detailed size, ownership, employee, registration, conflict-of-interest, prior-award or submission exclusions. No entry fee was identified in the official pages reviewed, but this contribution does not assert a guaranteed zero-cost participation state without the full RFI.
material_findings.prize_and_deadline_evidence: Army's official launch announcement says up to $1 million in cash prizes, Phase I Army SBIR and first-time STTR awards valued up to $300,000 each, applications open now, and apply by October 19, 2026 at 5:00 PM ET. USA.gov lists start September 10, 2026 at 5:00 PM ET, end October 19, 2026 at 5:00 PM ET and a $1,000,000 cash prize. The older Army competition detail page remains stale with 'Coming Soon' and Aug. 5-Sep. 30 metadata; do not use that stale timing as current truth.
material_findings.scope_and_safety: This is a legitimate prize/innovation opportunity, not authorization to test Army systems, networks, software, contracts or third-party assets. Any future work should be limited to a lawful competition submission under the final RFI and application terms.
